description: This is a Java source file defining a helper class for testing Akka persistence snapshots related to 'things' services within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class provides methods to retrieve the maximum snapshot and all snapshots in ascending order for a given domain ID, utilizing Akka persistence APIs.

classes.name: ThingsSnapshotTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class that provides functionality for testing with Akka persistence snapshots for the 'things' services. It allows retrieving the latest snapshot and all snapshots in ascending order for a given domain ID.

methods.name: ThingsSnapshotTestHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with actor system, snapshot conversion function, and domain ID to persistence ID mapping function.

methods.name: getMaxSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum (latest) snapshot for a given domain ID, if any exists.

methods.name: getAllSnapshotsAscending
methods.description: Retrieves all snapshots for a given domain ID, ordered from earliest to latest.

methods.name: convertSnapshotDataToDomainObject
methods.description: Converts a snapshot object to the domain-specific object using the provided conversion function.

methods.name: getAllSnapshotDataAscending
methods.description: Collects all snapshots in ascending order starting from the maximum snapshot.

methods.name: getMaxSnapshotDataBySequenceNumber
methods.description: Fetches the snapshot data with a sequence number less than or equal to a specified maximum for a given persistence ID.

methods.name: getMaxSnapshotData
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum snapshot data for a given persistence ID.

methods.name: convertScalaOpt
methods.description: Converts a Scala Option to a Java object, returning a default value if the Option is undefined.

methods.name: waitForFuture
methods.description: Waits synchronously for a future to complete with a timeout.
